stop_rules.condition: free space under 10 GiB, a hash that differs from its pinned value, an existing venv path, or a freeze difference

command:
set -eu
fail() { echo "G05_RESULT FAIL: $*"; if [ -n "${OUT:-}" ]; then echo "FAIL: $*" > "$OUT/result.txt"; fi; exit 3; }
h() { sha256sum "$1" | cut -d ' ' -f 1; }
E=/cmcode/env/training
R=/data/cbl1016/runtime
LOCK_SHA=c8725569731a4a768f90059b44b06a5e11c844ed18690ba85340b9a0c2ecdb0c
FREEZE_PC_SHA=6dc635728a209e08655e0241dbb165f025b2820b024b7c60f08ce7c2c20d850b
UV_TGZ_SHA=8cc1cd82d434ec565376f98bd938d4b715b5791a80ff2d3aa78821cf85091b4b
UV_PC_SHA=007b99a549b25f668d503535f4b1e21e3f34111318fd79bea50fada64f65eb9d
PY_PC_SHA=7d43f6e86a6c6dd12005ec77eb2055f1be3f1bb3adedf8afe0a87973fa7371ce
OUT=
[ -n "${RUN_ID:-}" ] || fail 'no run id label'
mkdir -p "$R/G05"
mkdir "$R/G05/$RUN_ID" || fail "output directory $R/G05/$RUN_ID exists"
OUT="$R/G05/$RUN_ID"
date -u | tee "$OUT/started.txt"
df -h /data | tee "$OUT/df.txt"
free=$(df -B1 --output=avail /data | tail -1 | tr -d ' ')
echo "avail_bytes $free" | tee -a "$OUT/df.txt"
[ "$free" -ge 10737418240 ] || fail "free space $free B is under 10 GiB"
ldd --version | head -1 | tee "$OUT/glibc.txt"
git -C /cmcode rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}' | tee "$OUT/checkout.txt"
[ "$(h "$E/requirements.lock.txt")" = "$LOCK_SHA" ] || fail 'lock hash differs from the handoff value'
VENV="$R/venv-$(echo "$LOCK_SHA" | cut -c1-12)"
[ ! -e "$VENV" ] || fail "$VENV exists; a venv is never rebuilt in place"
# Transient files (download, HOME, TMPDIR) go to the scratch emptyDir; everything kept goes to /data/cbl1016.
cd /scratch
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o uv.tgz https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/download/0.11.31/uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
[ "$(h uv.tgz)" = "$UV_TGZ_SHA" ] || fail 'uv 0.11.31 tarball hash differs from the release value'
tar -xzf uv.tgz
mkdir -p "$R/uv-0.11.31"
UV="$R/uv-0.11.31/uv"
if [ -e "$UV" ]; then
  [ "$(h "$UV")" = "$(h uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/uv)" ] || fail "$UV exists and differs from the release binary"
else
  cp uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/uv "$UV.part" && mv "$UV.part" "$UV"
fi
"$UV" --version | tee "$OUT/uv-version.txt"
u=$(h "$UV")
if [ "$u" = "$UV_PC_SHA" ]; then same=equal; else same=differs; fi
echo "uv binary sha256 $u; PC ~/.local/bin/uv $UV_PC_SHA; $same" | tee "$OUT/uv-binary.txt"
export UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR="$R/python" UV_CACHE_DIR="$R/uv-cache" UV_LINK_MODE=hardlink UV_NO_PROGRESS=1
"$UV" python install --no-bin 3.12.13
PY=$("$UV" python find --managed-python 3.12.13)
real=$(readlink -f "$PY")
p=$(h "$real")
if [ "$p" = "$PY_PC_SHA" ]; then same=equal; else same=differs; fi
echo "python $real sha256 $p; PC interpreter $PY_PC_SHA; $same" | tee "$OUT/python.txt"
cat "$(dirname "$(dirname "$real")")/BUILD" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/BUILD /' | tee -a "$OUT/python.txt" || true
"$UV" venv --python "$PY" "$VENV"
"$UV" pip sync --python "$VENV/bin/python" --require-hashes -c "$E/constraints.txt" "$E/requirements.lock.txt"
"$UV" pip freeze --python "$VENV/bin/python" > "$OUT/freeze.txt"
f=$(h "$OUT/freeze.txt")
echo "freeze sha256 $f lines $(wc -l < "$OUT/freeze.txt"); env/training/freeze.txt $(h "$E/freeze.txt"); PC venv $FREEZE_PC_SHA" | tee "$OUT/freeze-sha.txt"
cmp "$OUT/freeze.txt" "$E/freeze.txt" || fail 'freeze differs from env/training/freeze.txt'
[ "$f" = "$FREEZE_PC_SHA" ] || fail 'freeze differs from the PC venv freeze'
( cd "$VENV/lib/python3.12/site-packages" && sha256sum -c --quiet "$E/hgq2-0.1.9-installed-files.sha256" ) || fail 'hgq2 installed files differ'
echo "hgq2 installed files: 78 of 78 match" | tee "$OUT/hgq2-files.txt"
KERAS_BACKEND=jax WANDB_MODE=disabled "$VENV/bin/python" -I -c 'import jax, keras, hgq, wandb; print("jax", jax.__version__, "devices", jax.devices()); print("keras", keras.__version__, keras.backend.backend()); print("wandb", wandb.__version__)' > "$OUT/import.txt" 2>&1 || fail 'import check failed'
cat "$OUT/import.txt"
grep -q '^jax 0.9.2 devices \[CpuDevice' "$OUT/import.txt" || fail 'jax devices line is not the expected CPU-only list'
du -sh "$VENV" | tee "$OUT/venv-du.txt"
date -u | tee "$OUT/finished.txt"
echo "G05_RESULT PASS venv=$VENV freeze=$f" | tee "$OUT/result.txt"
